verses.text: In the third year of the reign of Jehoiakim king of Judah, Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon came to Jerusalem and besieged it.
verses.textZh: 猶大王約雅敬在位第三年，巴比倫王尼布甲尼撒來到耶路撒冷，將城圍困。

verses.text: The Lord gave Jehoiakim king of Judah into his hand, along with some of the vessels of the house of God; and he brought them to the land of Shinar, to the house of his god, and he brought the vessels into the treasury of his god.
verses.textZh: 主將猶大王約雅敬，並神殿中器皿的幾分交付他手。他就把這器皿帶到示拿地，收入他　神的廟裡，放在他　神的庫中。

verses.text: Then the king ordered Ashpenaz, the chief of his officials, to bring in some of the sons of Israel, including some of the royal family and of the nobles,
verses.textZh: 王吩咐太監長亞施毗拿，從以色列人的宗室和貴冑中帶進幾個人來，

verses.text: youths in whom was no defect, who were good-looking, showing intelligence in every [branch of] wisdom, endowed with understanding and discerning knowledge, and who had ability for serving in the king's court; and [he ordered him] to teach them the literature and language of the Chaldeans.
verses.textZh: 就是年少沒有殘疾、相貌俊美、通達各樣學問、知識聰明俱備、足能侍立在王宮裡的，要教他們迦勒底的文字言語。

verses.text: The king appointed for them a daily ration from the king's choice food and from the wine which he drank, and [appointed] that they should be educated three years, at the end of which they were to enter the king's personal service.
verses.textZh: 王派定將自己所用的膳和所飲的酒，每日賜他們一分，養他們三年。滿了三年，好叫他們在王面前侍立。

verses.text: Now among them from the sons of Judah were Daniel, Hananiah, Mishael and Azariah.
verses.textZh: 他們中間有猶大族的人：但以理、哈拿尼雅、米沙利、亞撒利雅。

verses.text: Then the commander of the officials assigned [new] names to them; and to Daniel he assigned [the name] Belteshazzar, to Hananiah Shadrach, to Mishael Meshach and to Azariah Abed-nego.
verses.textZh: 太監長給他們起名：稱但以理為伯提沙撒，稱哈拿尼雅為沙得拉，稱米沙利為米煞，稱亞撒利雅為亞伯尼歌。

verses.text: But Daniel made up his mind that he would not defile himself with the king's choice food or with the wine which he drank; so he sought [permission] from the commander of the officials that he might not defile himself.
verses.textZh: 但以理卻立志不以王的膳和王所飲的酒玷污自己，所以求太監長容他不玷污自己。

verses.text: Now God granted Daniel favor and compassion in the sight of the commander of the officials,
verses.textZh: 神使但以理在太監長眼前蒙恩惠，受憐憫。

verses.text: and the commander of the officials said to Daniel, 'I am afraid of my lord the king, who has appointed your food and your drink; for why should he see your faces looking more haggard than the youths who are your own age? Then you would make me forfeit my head to the king.'
verses.textZh: 太監長對但以理說：我懼怕我主我王，他已經派定你們的飲食；倘若他見你們的面貌比你們同歲的少年人肌瘦，怎麼好呢？這樣，你們就使我的頭在王那裡難保。

verses.text: But Daniel said to the overseer whom the commander of the officials had appointed over Daniel, Hananiah, Mishael and Azariah,
verses.textZh: 但以理對太監長所派管理但以理、哈拿尼雅、米沙利、亞撒利雅的委辦說：

verses.text: 'Please test your servants for ten days, and let us be given some vegetables to eat and water to drink.
verses.textZh: 求你試試僕人們十天，給我們素菜吃，白水喝，

verses.text: 'Then let our appearance be observed in your presence and the appearance of the youths who are eating the king's choice food; and deal with your servants according to what you see.'
verses.textZh: 然後看看我們的面貌和用王膳那少年人的面貌，就照你所看的待僕人罷！

verses.text: So he listened to them in this matter and tested them for ten days.
verses.textZh: 委辦便允准他們這件事，試看他們十天。

verses.text: At the end of ten days their appearance seemed better and they were fatter than all the youths who had been eating the king's choice food.
verses.textZh: 過了十天，見他們的面貌比用王膳的一切少年人更加俊美肥胖。

verses.text: So the overseer continued to withhold their choice food and the wine they were to drink, and kept giving them vegetables.
verses.textZh: 於是委辦撤去派他們用的膳，飲的酒，給他們素菜吃。

verses.text: As for these four youths, God gave them knowledge and intelligence in every [branch of] literature and wisdom; Daniel even understood all [kinds of] visions and dreams.
verses.textZh: 這四個少年人，神在各樣文字學問（學問：原文是智慧）上賜給他們聰明知識；但以理又明白各樣的異象和夢兆。

verses.text: Then at the end of the days which the king had specified for presenting them, the commander of the officials presented them before Nebuchadnezzar.
verses.textZh: 尼布甲尼撒王預定帶進少年人來的日期滿了，太監長就把他們帶到王面前。

verses.text: The king talked with them, and out of them all not one was found like Daniel, Hananiah, Mishael and Azariah; so they entered the king's personal service.
verses.textZh: 王與他們談論，見少年人中無一人能比但以理、哈拿尼雅、米沙利、亞撒利雅，所以留他們在王面前侍立。

verses.text: As for every matter of wisdom and understanding about which the king consulted them, he found them ten times better than all the magicians [and] conjurers who [were] in all his realm.
verses.textZh: 王考問他們一切事，就見他們的智慧聰明比通國的術士和用法術的勝過十倍。

verses.text: And Daniel continued until the first year of Cyrus the king.
verses.textZh: 到古列王元年，但以理還在。
